svg.title: NET-10 — All active sessions browser
svg.desc: NET-10-results. Compact upper Refresh: production bottom-left (710, 518), 112 by 24 logical px, right edge 822, 8 px above header top 510; 2 px outer focus leaves 6 px clearance from header and title strip at 550. Status retains its left origin with at least 8 px clearance from Refresh focus. Forward focus: Refresh, table, Previous, Next, Join selected, Direct connect, Back, Refresh; reverse reverses this cycle, skipping hidden or disabled controls. Approximate top-left diagram outside the exact footer; UX-NET-10-042 owns Refresh geometry. UX-NET-10-008 owns one footer row: Join selected (28,68), Direct connect (296,68), Back (564,68), each 252 by 32 logical px in production bottom-left coordinates, with 16 px gaps. SVG footer translates these bounds to canvas origin (25,20). Former second row empty. Table, selected details, reserved paging, eligibility and feedback unchanged. UX-NET-10-045 keeps protected ongoing later-match Started/Open selection joinable. UX-NET-10-043 retains next-round details and exact host confirmation within wrapping or scrolling selected details. UX-NET-10-044 pairs this selection with genuinely completed Closed. Stale rows are inspection-only; joining requires a successful refresh.

g.text: Match in progress. Your players join next round if admitted.
The host confirms availability when you connect.
LAN-first. A listing does not guarantee reachability.
Single page: paging hidden. If either direction exists, show both buttons and current page.
Stale: Join selected disabled; show Refresh before joining. Direct connect stays independent.
Selected details wrap or scroll. Row selection never bypasses NET-03 local-player setup.
Closed row: completed match. Status/paging stay reserved; unavailable page direction disabled.
